What we move,
and how.

01 — Services
Six specialised divisions
Pan-India coverage
— 01

Household Shifting

Door-to-door home relocation handled by trained crews. Furniture dismantling, fragile-grade wrapping, labelled cartons, and unpacking at the destination.

  • Two- and three-tier wrapping for fragile items
  • Furniture dismantling & reassembly
  • Insurance & transit-damage cover
— 02

E-Commerce Fulfilment

Pick, pack and ship for online sellers. Same-day dispatch windows, return management, and SKU-level tracking from our warehouse to the customer's door.

  • SKU storage & cycle counts
  • Multi-courier dispatch routing
  • RTO handling & quality re-check
— 03

Office & Industrial

Plant relocations, office moves, IT hardware transfers and laboratory shifting with anti-static padding, crating, and overnight crews to minimise downtime.

  • Server & IT-rack handling
  • Plywood crating for machinery
  • Phased move-in scheduling
— 04

Warehousing & Storage

Short and long-term storage in racked, ventilated warehouses with 24×7 supervision, fire safety, and inventory dashboards for business clients.

  • Racked & pallet storage
  • CCTV & on-site supervision
  • Pest-controlled, dry-bay zones
— 05

Pan-India Transport

Full-truckload, part-load and parcel movements across all major Indian cities. Dedicated trucks, GPS-tracked, with documented chain-of-custody.

  • Full-truckload (FTL) & LTL
  • Live GPS tracking
  • e-Way bill compliance
— 06

Specialised & Fragile

Pianos, art, glassware, machinery and lab equipment moved with custom crating, foam-shaping and climate-aware vehicles where required.

  • Custom plywood crating
  • Foam-cut padding & bracing
  • Climate-aware transit

From your door
to their hands.

02 — The lifecycle
Seven mapped stages
Live status at each step
— 01

Enquiry & Survey

Phone, WhatsApp or on-site visit to assess load, fragility and route.

— 02

Quote & Booking

Written estimate, GST invoice, advance receipt and pickup slot confirmed.

— 03

Pickup & Pack

Trained crew, multi-layer wrapping, labelled cartons, photographic record.

— 04

Warehouse In

Inbound check, SKU tagging, racked storage with dashboard visibility.

— 05

Sort & Stage

Route bagging, fragile-tagging and dispatch-zone staging by destination.

— 06

Dispatch

Loaded into Tata Ace, Eicher or 32-ft container with sealed locks.

— 07

Last-Mile

Doorstep handover, OTP-based delivery and signed proof on file.

Fragile · 3-Layer
Corrugated · 5-ply
Scanned · SKU
Dispatch Bay
Specialty · 03

Built for online sellers.

D2C brands and Amazon, Flipkart & Meesho sellers depend on us for the unglamorous work that keeps their reviews five-star: clean SKU intake, careful packing, and dispatch windows you can plan a marketing calendar around.

— A

Inbound & QC

Brand goods received, counted, photographed, and stored against your SKU master.

— B

Sensitive Packing

Bubble, foam, void-fill and double-walled cartons — by item category, not one-size-fits-all.

— C

Multi-Courier

Dispatch via Delhivery, Bluedart, DTDC, India Post or your courier of choice.

— D

Returns Handled

RTO inspection, repackaging where viable, and shelf-restock — closing the loop.

A fleet sized
for every load.

Heritage · 07

Twenty-five years
of quietly reliable
logistics.

JRW began in 1998 with one truck and a handshake commitment: that what we picked up would arrive intact, on time, and exactly where it was meant to be. Three generations of the same family have grown the firm, but the handshake hasn't changed.

Today we serve everyone from young D2C brands shipping their first hundred orders to industrial clients moving entire factories — and we still pack every fragile carton like it belongs to our own family.

— 1998
Founded

One Tata pickup, three crew members, and a Maharashtra-only route map.

— 2006
First warehouse

Moved into our first racked facility; expanded to inter-state movement.

— 2014
E-commerce arm

Launched dedicated SKU-level fulfilment for online sellers.

— 2020
Pan-India network

Reached 200+ cities through our partner-vehicle network.

— 2025
Today

Three warehouses, 60+ vehicles, and the same 1998 commitment.

Trusted, quietly,
by clients who stay.
